summary: First-finish smoke tests for ND Curtains site. Backend consultation endpoints (POST/GET) and frontend hero+quote-form flow all pass. Data persists end-to-end.
passed: POST /api/consultations with valid body returns 200 + Consultation with generated uuid `id` and ISO `created_at`
POST /api/consultations with invalid email returns 422 (pydantic EmailStr validation)
GET /api/consultations returns list sorted by created_at desc
Home page loads at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL with hero-section, hero-title, hero-quote-btn, hero-draw-btn visible
hero-draw-btn toggles label between 'DRAW THE CURTAINS' and 'CLOSE THE CURTAINS' on click
All required sections present: about-section, services-section, gallery-section, testimonials-section, quote-section
Empty submit on quote-form shows sonner error toast 'Please fill in your name, email, phone and service.' and does not POST
Filling all inputs + selecting service via shadcn Select (service-option-Custom Curtains) + submit shows success toast 'Thank you! We\'ll be in touch shortly...' and resets the form
Submitted consultation is retrievable via GET /api/consultations (verified by matching unique name)
notes: Framer-motion delayed opacity animation (~0.75s) on hero CTAs can cause Playwright's default actionability check to time out; used JS click as reliable alternative. UI is fully functional for real users.
Only warning in console: 'THREE.Clock: This module has been deprecated. Please use THREE.Timer instead.' — non-blocking.
Email notification intentionally skipped (RESEND_API_KEY not set) — matches problem statement.
